text:
marie_cs: Heads-up from today's NorthBay onboarding: overall happy with embeddings, but billing surprise triggered a renewal concern. Dropping raw notes so we can decide next steps quickly.

sasha_pm: ack. please paste the asks and any verbatim language we can use in PRD/exec.

marie_cs: paste below. three asks + one renewal warning.

1) Visibility: they want per-route + per-project cost breakdown in the console (not just aggregate invoice).
2) Dev cost mode: a lower-cost dev/test inference profile (lower batching, cheaper hardware routing) for small teams.
3) Webhook/external integration: clearer retry timeline & a linkable trace in the UI.

Renewal note: CFO emailed my contact: "Week 1 invoice jumped to $4.8k, we need a breakdown or we'll pause renewal discussions."

dan_product: good quote to include. For the per-route visibility, do we want a UI-first or CSV-export-first approach?

rachel_fin: CSV/export-first is quickest. We can produce a nightly per-request export with columns: request_id, route, model, tokens_prompt, tokens_completion, compute_cost, timestamp. Finance can ship a sample CSV tomorrow if they grant access.

aj_support: temporary mitigation: we can run an ad-hoc export for them now and surface request->invoice mapping. Also I can add a KB doc with steps to reconcile invoices with request IDs.

evan_eng: dev-cost-mode: we already have knobs: max_batch_size, prefer_spot, kv_cache_enabled. A prescriptive profile ("dev") that sets max_batch_size=1, prefer_spot=true, kv_cache_enabled=false could cut cost per-request by ~60% for tiny loads but increase latency. Spike estimate: 1 week to validate across 2 models, 2 sprints total to ship a guarded rollout.

sasha_pm: sounds like prioritization: Billing visualization = critical (renewal risk), CSV export + manual bridge = immediate short-term, dev-profile = medium, webhook UX = short but lower risk.

marie_cs: my recommendation: P0 = billing visibility (customer-level renewal at risk), P1 = ad-hoc CSV + KB + short webhook permalink, P2 = dev-cost profile.

dan_product: agree. I'll draft a small PRD focused on "Per-route Billing Visibility" with a mock table + toggle and include the CFO quote. I'll aim to have a 1-pager by Thu EOD.

rachel_fin: finance will prepare sample export schema by tomorrow EOD. I'll attach sample CSV to PRD.

aj_support: I'll prepare the reconciliation KB and the email template asking for last invoice + request IDs. Posting template here: ```
Hi <name>,
Can you share the invoice PDF and a few sample request IDs (from week X)? We'll map those to route-level usage and send a reconciled CSV.
Thanks,
AJ
```

onboarding-bot: Recording + transcript uploaded: https://redwood-recordings/company/4851236789/northbay-onboard-2026-03-24.mp4

evan_eng: if we end up needing a fast spike for dev-mode, I can allocate a 20% spike this sprint to produce perf/cost numbers. We'll need product to define acceptable latency targets.

marie_cs: outreach: I already offered a short billing review call with finance and manual export. Customer accepted and scheduled for 48h. That should reduce immediate churn pressure. I'll update Gainsight renewal flag after PRD lands.

sasha_pm: I'll add this to roadmap candidates and include cost/ROI notes. Dan, please tag me in the PRD.

dan_product: will do. Action items: 1) Dan -> PRD for Billing Visibility by Thu EOD. 2) Rachel -> sample CSV/schema by tomorrow EOD. 3) AJ -> KB + email template (done) and run manual export. 4) Evan -> spike plan for dev-cost profile (estimate next Tue). 5) Marie -> run customer follow-up and update Gainsight.

marie_cs: thanks all. Please update this thread with progress so I can re-open renewal mitigation steps if needed. :thumbsup:
